title: Polygon Siskiu T9 Review: The Swiss Army Knife
description:
The second bike of our 2024 value trail bike head to head test is the Polygon Siskiu T9. Of all the bikes we rode for this years test, this one surprised us the most. It's dialed, gravity-oriented part spec makes the Siskiu T9 feel a lot bigger than its 135 mm of travel would suggest; for better and for worse! Hear all of our pros and cons in the video!

Watch the rest of the content from our value trail bike head to head test here: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PLcNCeDcGO_4XIW30qdYoBRBbjtkbihI2l&si=Is_6_7BN5_tCJMvb

See how all the bikes we tested compare at 99spokes.com! https://99spokes.com/compare?bikes=rockymountain-instinct-a10-shimano-2024;*z.lg-steep-29-29,polygon-siskiu-t9-2024;*z.lg-29-29,canyon-neuron-6-2024;*z.lg-29-29,ibis-ripmo-af-gx-2024,ari-cascade-peak-pro-2024

0:42 Pros
4:20 Cons
